patients.label: 89-year-old woman with a left forearm mass diagnosed as primary cutaneous follicle centre lymphoma with Hodgkin and Reed-Sternberg like cells

identity_evidence.quote: We present a rare case of IgH-bcl2 negative FL with H/RS cells presenting as a solitary mass on the forearm of an 89-year-old woman.

attribution_limitations: The case report text says the lack of IgH-bcl2 fusion and absence of lymphadenopathy "favor" the diagnosis, while the abstract, title and conclusion state the case as primary cutaneous follicle centre lymphoma with H/RS-like cells. The diagnosis is recorded as stated by the authors; hedging is not resolved.
The abstract calls the FISH target "IgH-bcl2 fusion transcript" whereas the case text says "IgH-bcl2 fusion"; the observation uses the case-text wording and no inference is added.

The source says "no other treatment was initiated", which may imply the authors regarded the excision as treatment, but it never states that the excision was therapeutic; the excision stays a diagnostic procedure and is not recorded as an oncology treatment.

The anti-EBV latent membrane protein antibody, FISH and PCR sentences do not name the specimen tested; they are not linked to the excised tumor (tumor_ref null) and their event is not ordered against the excision.
